title: The Uncharted Monsoon
author: I. M. Nystrom
blurb: Lena Zhou, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent seven years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
